pages.title: Steller Sea Lion
pages.text: The Steller sea lion ($(o)Eumetopias jubatus$()) is the largest sea lion, found on the rocky coasts of the northern Pacific.$(br2)Unlike true seals, it can turn its hind flippers forward and walk on all four limbs, and it swims by beating its long front flippers.$(br2)Bulls are much larger than females, with a thick mane-like neck.
